svg.title: A join is row multiplication, not a Venn diagram
svg.desc: Three order rows linked to seven order-item rows, producing a joined result of seven rows in which each order's total is repeated once per item; the repeated totals are ringed in red. A Venn diagram is crossed out because it cannot show duplicates. Two SUM boxes show the correct 507,507,500 against the join-inflated 1,522,492,500, a 3.0x difference with no error raised. Below, INNER, LEFT, RIGHT and FULL joins are drawn as result rows with NULL ghosts.
svg.text: A join is row multiplication, not a Venn diagram
the same total, written three times
if a join can multiply rows, aggregate the
child FIRST, then join to that summary.
nested loop 9.5 ms · hash 1 148 ms · merge 742 ms
· EXISTS and IN give the identical plan
